messages:
maya: Heads-up — kicking off a config-only push (routing policy + per-tenant limits + batching tweaks) to canary-A now. change-id cfg-2026-0421. Target 10% traffic for 30m. @deploy-bot please start canary :robot_face:

deploy-bot: Scheduled change cfg-2026-0421. Canary target: canary-A. Starting at 10:15 UTC. Initial traffic: 10% for 30m. Health checks: p50/p95 latency, error_rate, tokens/sec every 1m. Command: `/deploy start --change cfg-2026-0421 --canary canary-A --pct 10`

sam: Quick q — what's the biggest risk here? timeout regression, or routing thrash from the new policy? Also do we need to pin any model or variant for canary?

liam: Main risk is burst throttle fallout. Changes: per-tenant rateLimiter 500->300 rps, route timeout default 1200ms->900ms for low-latency routes, batching target for low-latency class 8->6. No model binary changes; we will pin routing-variant to `stable-2026-04` during canary.

jessie: Sounds good. Decision rule: if throttles cause downstream error_rate >0.5% or p95 increases >200ms for 5m, rollback. Also FYI enterprise customer Acrosoft uses a dedicated pool — make sure account team knows nothing touches that.

deploy-bot: Canary started: cfg-2026-0421 -> canary-A at 10:15:23 UTC. Metrics stream: https://metrics.redwood.example/cfg-2026-0421/canary-A

liam: Canary 5m update: error_rate 0.12% (baseline 0.09%), p95 latency +70ms, p50 +12ms, avg batch size 5.9 (baseline 6.0), tokens/sec -1.2%. No tail spike. No increased user errors. Propose ramp to 30% in 20m.

maya: Go for 30%. Keep Acrosoft pinned and excluded. @deploy-bot ramp to 30% in 2m.

deploy-bot: Rolling canary to 30%: cfg-2026-0421 now at 30% on canary-A. Watch health checks for next 30m.

sam: Noting a regional blip — eu-west p50 jumped +150ms, looks like fallback routing path triggered twice for two ASGs. Suggest applying region override to restore previous routing decision for eu-west only, keep batching changes global.

liam: Agreed. Applying `override.region.eu-west.routing = stable-2026-03` (only routing policy revert). Command: `/config apply --change cfg-2026-0421 --patch "override.region.eu-west.routing=stable-2026-03"`

jessie: 👍 patch it. If eu-west doesn't improve in 10m, we do a full rollback. Notify support and logs channel.

deploy-bot: Applied override: cfg-2026-0421-override-eu-west at 10:34:12 UTC. Patch link: https://configs.redwood.example/changes/cfg-2026-0421/overrides/eu-west

liam: eu-west 5m after override: p50 back to baseline, error_rate unchanged. Global metrics stable. Recommend continuing rollout and then drafting release notes.

maya: OK, continue rollout to 70% in quiet window tonight (02:00-04:00 UTC) then full if metrics stay healthy. Final rollout notes to add: "Config-only: lowered per-tenant rate limit to 300 rps, reduced route timeouts to 900ms for low-latency routes, adjusted low-latency batching target to 6. Applied eu-west routing override during rollout."

jessie: I'll add the release note bullet and ping account team for Acrosoft. Closing thread unless anyone objects. :white_check_mark:
